syn: ip [ OPTIONS ] address { COMMAND | help } ⏎ ip address { add | change | replace } IFADDR dev IFNAME [ LIFETIME ] [ CONFFLAG-LIST ] ⏎ ip address delete IFADDR dev IFNAME [ mngtmpaddr ] ⏎ ip address { save | flush } [ dev IFNAME ] [ scope SCOPE-ID ] [ metric METRIC ] [ to PREFIX ] [ FLAG-LIST ] [ label PATTERN ] [ { up | down } ] ⏎ ip address [ show [ dev IFNAME ] [ scope SCOPE-ID ] [ to PREFIX ] [ FLAG-LIST ] [ label PATTERN ] [ master DEVICE ] [ type TYPE ] [ vrf NAME ] [ { up | down } ] [ nomaster ] proto ADDRPROTO ] ] ⏎ ip address { showdump | restore }

o.en: (IPv6 only) only list addresses which are not in the process of duplicate address detection currently.
(IPv6 only) only list addresses not being deprecated.
(IPv6 only) only list addresses which have not failed duplicate address detection.
These flags are aliases for primary.
This is an alias for temporary or secondary.
